cachB_4class.description: Train on Cách B (92 sessions, 4-class: benign+boolean+time), test on split
cachB_4class.note: limited data (92 sessions), but FPR=0.0 for benign class

hybrid_AB_v2.description: Train on A+B combined (1492 sessions), test on held-out (299 sessions)
hybrid_AB_v2.note: slightly better ablation than v1 (drop_B1=0.9773 vs 0.9606) — B2+gap helpful

cross_A2B_v2.description: Train on ALL A (1400 sessions), test on ALL B (92 sessions)
cross_A2B_v2.finding: Complete cross-domain failure. B2 score polarity reversed (+2.31→-2.49 for boolean, +10.98→-2.43 for time). Query format differs: Cách A stores full SQL, Cách B stores injection payload only.
cross_A2B_v2.root_cause_b2: Cách A attack B2=+2.31/10.98 (anomalous), Cách B attack B2=-2.49/-2.43 (normal). URL encoding + HTTP framing changes statistical features.

cross_B2A_v2.description: Train on ALL B (92 sessions), test on ALL A (1400 sessions)
cross_B2A_v2.finding: Cách B boolean_blind generalizes perfectly to Cách A bool (DR=1.0). time_blind does not (DR=0.0) — SLEEP-based timing patterns differ.

key_insight: B2 score is the PRIMARY domain mismatch. Cách B attack queries bypass B2's anomaly detector (negative score = 'normal') because HTTP-level framing changes statistical features vs bare SQL. To deploy in production, MUST train on real HTTP traffic (Cách B) — synthetic SQL-only data (Cách A) does not generalize.
